description: Authority policy defining what each subsystem may do with the Master Library.

URI.description: Read-only access to library indexes and reports. May append operator decision records only.

Broker.description: Read-only access to library indexes for context building. Writes memory context packet to broker inbox.

PRAXIS.description: May read approved compressed summaries, validated reports, ontology definitions, and operator decisions only. Must not ingest raw archive files.

sandbox_agi.description: Read access to active and compressed memory, ontology, and operator decisions. May submit proposals only. No direct library writes.

Audit.description: Full read access for audit purposes. May write audit reports only.

Snapshot.description: May read library indexes and configs for snapshot manifest generation.

Librarian.description: Index authority. May scan all paths, write artifact registry, subsystem registry, scan receipts, and reports.

DecayJudge.description: Scoring authority. May write queue files and decay reports. Cannot delete or move files.

Archivist.description: Dry-run mutation authority only. May write compression summaries and receipts. Deletion permanently disabled in Phase 18.1.
